facts: Stress CPU/DIMM/HDD for five minutes, physically drop/replug AC, repeat ten times.
Expect normal recovery, AC-drop logs and no device loss.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes stress-ng and human cable action.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with safe AC handling and per-cycle checks.

original_test_intent.statement: Validate recovery from ten deliberate AC removals while CPU, memory and storage stress is active for five minutes before each drop.
must_preserve: Ten physical AC events, five-minute pre-drop combined stress and expected AC-loss logging.
unknowns: Approved stress mix, AC-off/replug dwell, boot timeout and storage/filesystem protection.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It should explicitly protect storage write state and distinguish expected AC-loss records from unexpected platform faults.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Physical AC removal remains manual; every cycle needs a safe storage profile and correlated expected-versus-unexpected log evaluation.

revision_candidate.test_name: Recover from Ten AC Drops During CPU/Memory/Storage Stress
revision_candidate.purpose: For ten cycles, run the approved combined stress for five minutes, remove AC through the safe fixture, restore power and verify full recovery plus correct AC-loss logging.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Dedicated fully populated SUT with isolated AC fixture, OOB access and disposable/non-destructive storage target.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Exactly ten cycles; CPU, host DDR and approved storage target. GPU/network are inventory checks, not inferred stress targets.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Stress profile/package, safe storage target, AC-off/on dwell/waveform, boot-ready timeout, expected SEL event pattern, inventory baseline and recovery approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Agent may start/monitor bounded five-minute stress; operator performs each numbered AC action. After each restore, capture boot, inventory, filesystem/storage and expected AC-loss evidence before next cycle.
revision_candidate.preconditions: No production data/write cache exposure; fixture/grounding/OOB and shutdown-risk acceptance confirmed.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Per-cycle stress interval, AC timestamps/waveform, boot result, full inventory, filesystem/storage health, expected AC-loss SEL and unexpected log deltas.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: All ten cycles recover within timeout with complete inventory/data health and only permitted AC-loss events.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No credential-in-command examples, arbitrary disk write, manual live connector handling outside approved fixture, log clearing or hidden retry.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Qualified operator performs AC actions; owners approve stress/data risk and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: AC control is physical; workload/evidence may be automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Leave power safe, preserve failed-cycle data, verify filesystem/devices and recover via OOB before any authorized retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unsafe connector/fixture, storage error, failed boot, missing device, hang/BSOD, unexpected SEL or evidence gap.

identified_defects: Expected AC event not separated from faults.
reason_for_change: Power loss during disk activity is materially different from ordinary reboot; V3 makes storage ownership and per-cycle integrity recovery explicit.
removed_ambiguities: CPU/DIMM/HDD stress is preserved; other populated devices are health checks.
remaining_blockers: Stress, storage and AC waveform inputs.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 adds the missing write-state/data-integrity boundary and requires the expected AC-loss event to be correlated without treating all SEL entries as failures.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 69 performs five-minute CPU/DIMM/HDD stress before each of ten physical AC drops.
